# Warzone flag-win reward from ASSS 1.4.4 src/scoring/points_flag.c (compiled
# unmodified). Fired when one freq holds every flag (fg_wz).
# flagwin <players in arena> <players on the winning freq> <Flag:FlagReward> <points>
# points = players * players * FlagReward / 1000, where `players` counts every human
# in the arena who is playing and not in spec -- NOT just the winning freq, and the
# on-freq count does not enter the formula at all. Integer division truncates.
# scoring/jackpot.c, when attached, adds the arena jackpot to this and then resets it;
# ASSS awards the result to each player on the winning freq.
